# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest release of Dolabım receives security updates.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.43.x  | :white_check_mark: |
| < 1.43  | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a potential security vulnerability in Dolabım (Web or Android), please report it responsibly:

1. **Do not** disclose vulnerabilities publicly in issues or discussions.
2. Submit a private advisory via [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/kyhlaer/Dolabim/security/advisories/new) or contact the maintainer through GitHub profile links.
3. Include:
   - Type of issue (e.g. XSS, authentication bypass, data exposure).
   - Clear reproduction steps or proof-of-concept.
   - Impact assessment on end users or data integrity.

We appreciate responsible disclosure and aim to acknowledge and patch verified vulnerabilities promptly.
